title.zh: 圆的认识 · 圆规、半径与 π
title.en: The Circle · Compass, Radius and π

desc.zh: 圆规一转画出圆；把圆周拉直量一量，周长总是直径的 3 倍多一点——这个倍数就是 π。
desc.en: A compass sweeps out a circle; unroll its edge and it is always a little over 3 diameters long: that multiple is π.
